title: The Arnolfini Portrait (Jan van Eyck)
moodDescription: Early Flemish Renaissance intimacy; luminous sacred domesticity, velvet drapery, and solemn marital vows

regions.label: Giovanni Arnolfini (The Merchant)
regions.spokenLabel: The tall, austere Italian merchant raising his right hand in solemn pledge, draped in a heavy fur-trimmed purple tabard and dark hat.
regions.timbreDescription: Renaissance viola da gamba & solemn wooden organ

regions.label: Giovanna Cenami (The Bride)
regions.spokenLabel: The bride in a magnificent voluminous green woolen gown lined with white ermine fur, head bowed gracefully in quiet devotion.

regions.label: The Joined Hands (Sacred Vow)
regions.spokenLabel: The tender physical center of the painting where the groom gently cradles the bride's open right palm.
regions.timbreDescription: Intimate classical Renaissance lute & silver bell

regions.label: Convex Mirror & Chandelier
regions.spokenLabel: A miniature brass chandelier with one burning candle hanging above a round convex mirror reflecting the entire room and two hidden witnesses.
regions.timbreDescription: High wooden organ flutes & cathedral reverb

regions.label: The Loyal Dog & Wooden Pattens
regions.spokenLabel: A shaggy Brussels griffon dog standing between the couple symbolising steadfast fidelity, beside wooden outdoor clogs on the floor.
